note: Split polymorphonuclear from mononuclear leukocytes on CD14 × SSC. PMN: granulocytes — upper cluster at high SSC and CD14-low (granulocytes have large granular cytoplasm → high SSC, and are CD14-low). Non_PMN: mononuclear leukocytes — lower cluster at low-to-mid SSC (lymphocytes, monocytes, DCs; includes CD14+ monocytes resolved downstream).
tips: Split polymorphonuclear (granulocytes) from mononuclear leukocytes. PMN: SSC-high and CD14-negative (granulocytes have large granular cytoplasm → high SSC, and are CD14-low). Non_PMN: SSC-lower (lymphocytes, monocytes, DCs; includes CD14+ monocytes resolved downstream). In-panel co-marker prior: there is no positive granulocyte lineage marker in this panel, so PMN is defined by scatter morphology plus CD14-negativity; the remaining in-panel markers (CD3, CD19, HLA-DR, CD11c, CD1c, CD303, CD123, CD86, CD16) do not add discriminative power at this split — CD16 is reserved for the downstream neutrophil / eosinophil separation at Step 7.
